scope: Read-only analysis of existing traces and logs; diagnostic display-lane copies only; no training-source/config/runner changes or GPU experiments.
units: Perfetto ts/dur ns; summaries ms. Kernel sums are not elapsed time or projected gains.

import_reconciliation.initial_ranges_only_attempt: Removing 3871 GPU user ranges did not fix the 417 overlapping kernel losses; not used for final GPU totals.
import_reconciliation.root_cause: Raw same-stream CuTe kernel timestamps overlap; parser rejects crossing complete slices. Display-lane coloring preserves timestamps/durations/args.stream and relocates matching GPU flow endpoints.
import_reconciliation.rank1_limit: Original import drops 537 overlapping complete events. Only CPU frame/loader/capacity and intact CE name/count results used; no rank1 global GPU budget claimed.

capacity_no_drop_proof.formula: 8 ranks * (2*4096) source tokens * top8 <= (50000//8)*128. Thus every destination-group load <=524288<800000; the group-overload gate is always false for this exact crop layout.
capacity_no_drop_proof.limit: Does not apply to EP32 or a larger token bound; preserve configured capacity, group gating and stable score/tie rules.

source_inferences.logits_shape: [4,2048,128256] BF16, from active folded MTP1 loss, B2, two chunks; shapes were not recorded by profiler.

limitations: One profiled optimizer update, not a performance A/B experiment. No candidate speedup is proven.
Rank0 train-step annotation is 14.337954319s; profiler-return cadence 17.918091177s includes capture/export and is not the same timer.
Unprofiled baseline is a separate single-run 145163.837099 global input tokens/s, with no new monitoring-off A/A noise estimate.
GPU annotations are removed only in analysis copies. CPU and original GPU/flow timing retained; actual args.stream must define stream grouping after lane coloring.
Host synchronization time overlaps queued GPU work; its 6.611s sum is not removable step latency.
Communication-only time does not by itself prove consumer blocking. HybridEP kernels mix transport, permutation, reduction and peer waiting.
Trace has no tensor shapes, Python stacks or memory snapshots. No candidate memory saving was measured.

Broad GDN total-device range join failed with an RPC response decode error; a concurrent forward aggregate then failed to send to the processor. Both are retained; use completed bounded parent-context query only. No retry or GDN whole-block aggregate claim.
Eight-H100 EP8 single-node crop does not establish production EP32, PP or inter-node behavior.
